effect_evidence.note: Frozen independent effect evidence for the SRE `successful_full_loop` dimension. The prediction is bound to the ActionType the replay builds; the authoritative observation comes from a source that never receives the executor receipt, so closure cannot be satisfied by dispatch success. The negative cases are the fail-closed evidence classes: missing, stale, incomplete, and conflicting.

negative_cases.note: No authoritative observation was produced before closure was attempted.
The only observation arrived after the prediction's observation deadline.
The observation does not cover the predicted metric, so the evidence set is incomplete.
The authoritative observation contradicts the prediction it is correlated to.

note: SRE observability precondition: a cluster with no diagnostic settings emits no SLO signal, so a burn-rate alert can never fire and the reliability objective is unmeasurable. Props fire ONLY diagnostic-settings-required; rbac_enabled, private_cluster_enabled, and a non-empty network_policy satisfy the co-resident kubernetes-cluster rules so the citing set stays single-rule.
